description: Customer billing: the outside customers. v = fxMoney.billing(state, store.view('billing'), ui): scenario 3 (FleetCo invoices its rental customers, with a dry run of each Fusion AR invoice, VAT and e-invoicing by Fusion; deposits taken and settled after the return), scenario 2 (ProjectCo bills Customer X at cost plus mark-up, PPM contract billing or an EquipRite invoice, never both) and the customer invoices with their open amounts, payments and accounting (shown, not posted). Set by loadChain on vbEnter and on every fxRefresh; actions through actChain, links through openChain, the page's own state through setChain.

ui.description: The invoices and previews whose accounting is open (openTx).

failure.description: The last action that did not go through, in words, shown where it happened (fxMoney.failure).

exportOpen.description: The list whose export menu is open ('' = none).

fxRefresh.description: From the page module (fxPage.watch): the store changed, so loadChain runs again.
